title: Importance of Quran Recitation
summary: This discusses the value of Quran recitation in life and its benefits in the afterlife.
translation:
Our dealings should include the importance of Quran recitation as a crucial part of our lives. The recitation of the Holy Quran is vital for our personal life and offers great benefits in the hereafter, serving as an intercessor on our behalf before Allah. Allah has conveyed through the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) the virtues of the Quran, indicating the value of a person who recites it. There is a hadith that states those not granted through supplication might receive more from Quran recitation. Therefore, a person engrossed in Quran recitation may receive more than one who devotes themselves to supplication. The Quran, being the word of Allah, contains descriptions of His greatness and commands, and through recitation, one cleanses their heart. A hadith illustrates how hearts rust like iron exposed to water and become useless unless purified through remembrance of death and extensive Quran recitation, allowing them to humbly submit before Allah.

Even those who read with difficulty earn double the reward—one for the struggle and one for recitation—while skilled reciters are also rewarded immensely. One should not feel discouraged about their ability to recite compared to experts, as Allah appreciates their effort and grants them double the reward. Therefore, we should make Quran recitation part of our daily routine, aiming to finish a portion each day, whether a full section in the morning before dawn or before sleep at night, or at least a page if not more. Reciting the Quran brightens our vision, enlivens our hearts, and renews our commitment to following Shariah commands. May Allah grant us the ability to engage in good actions and bond with the Quran.
